description.fallback: With Polnareff as their driver, the Joestar group is driving through the northern part of India to Pakistan. They come across a car in front of them, which Polnareff overtakes and bounces rocks at tauntingly. He's scolded by Joseph for being a reckless driver, as they need to avoid attracting attention since Joseph is wanted for murder in the city of Benares.

text.fallback: Head out: Wheel of Fortune, Part 1

outro.fallback: The driver lets Polnareff pass him again, tricking him into accelerating and almost colliding with a truck, but Jotaro uses Star Platinum to reduce the damage from the accident.
The group tries to get a glimpse of the driver, but they only manage to see his muscular arm.
